north_star.definition: A user is considered a WAL if they have a sessions_last_7d count of >= 3 AND an exercises_completed_7d count of >= 5

measurable_proxy.definition: The number of sessions a user has had in the last 7 days
measurable_proxy.predictive_reasoning: Hitting this proxy statistically predicts success for the North Star Metric because it indicates a user's engagement with the platform
